name: LLM Argumentation Benchmark
description: A comprehensive benchmark exploring the potential of LLMs in computational argumentation, organizing existing tasks into six main categories and standardizing fourteen openly available datasets. It includes a new benchmark dataset on counter speech generation to holistically evaluate end-to-end LLM performance on argument mining and argument generation.
reputation: Published at ACL 2024 (Long Papers); first comprehensive assessment of LLMs across the full argumentation pipeline
notes: Evaluates ChatGPT, Flan models, and LLaMA2 in zero-shot and few-shot settings; LLMs show commendable performance across most datasets; standardizes 14 datasets across 6 argumentation task categories.
